fi-opistognathus-aurifrons.title: Yellowhead Jawfish (Pearly Jawfish)
fi-opistognathus-aurifrons.summary: A jawfish that digs its own burrow and stays close to it. Peaceful and fun to watch.
rows: About 4 in; wild record 10 cm (3.9 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore. Frozen meaty foods such as mysis and brine shrimp
Western Central Atlantic: southern Florida, USA and Bahamas to Barbados and northern South America
notes: Needs a deep bed (about 5–7 in) of mixed sand and rubble to build its burrow.
Other burrowing fish may bully it.
warn: Jumps when startled. Keep a tight lid.
